reviewer: independent oracle worker /root/open_loop; production authored by /root/consumer_lookups
method: Manual read-only review of the frozen Rust implementation and tests; no production edits and no duplicated Rust build. Frozen file identity independently checked against exact git objects.
verdict: no blocking finding within the stated bounded mechanism foundation scope

checks.finding: Persisted form contains only algorithm, public salt, iteration count, StoredKey and ServerKey; import rejects undersized salt, unsupported iteration work and wrong fixed key sizes. Internal password/salted password/client key/key ownership uses zeroizing wrappers.

Worker semaphore is acquired fail-fast before spawn_blocking and moved into its closure. Caller cancellation sets a separate flag; queued jobs check before work, running jobs keep their permit through actual completion and discard success after cancellation.

Exact three NUL-delimited components, valid UTF-8 and bounded identities/passwords precede lookup/derivation; empty/self authorization policy is enforced and fixed-size stored-key verification uses CtOutput.

Replacement checks bounded record count, duplicate identity/algorithm entries and checked generation advancement; short try_write/try_read sections fail Busy rather than blocking an executor. Admitted sessions retain their original immutable generation.

First attempt is terminal on every error, including randomness or malformed input. GS2 n, empty/self authorization, checked escapes, ASCII SCRAM name, nonce and combined length limits are enforced before bounded challenge retention.

finish consumes the session, takes its challenge exactly once and sends proof verification to a bounded blocking job. Cancellation drops session admission while the actual worker retains its own permit.

Messages are bounded valid UTF-8 without control characters; at most 16 unique alphabetic attributes are admitted, unsupported mandatory m is rejected, and the required n/r and c/r/p order is validated by callers.

The original first-bare, exact server-first and original final-without-proof bytes form AuthMessage. Binding equals base64(exact GS2), nonce equals the full challenge nonce and decoded proof has exact digest size before secret-output comparison through RustCrypto CtOutput::Eq. Server signature is returned only after authentication.

Private deterministic fixture replay compares derived StoredKey/ServerKey and exact successful challenge/final signature against authentic Apache and literal/derived RFC fixtures; deliberate hardening outcomes remain separate from Apache acceptance.

Tests hold a real blocking worker or occupy a one-thread blocking queue, abort the caller, observe separate admissions/workers, reject competing work, then prove release occurs on actual completion or queued skip.

boundaries: Only server mechanism primitives are reviewed: no Kafka dispatch, TLS/channel lifecycle, live Kafka session, reauthentication, delegation-token or full interoperability assertion.
Kafka raw UTF-8 password handling and ASCII-only SCRAM username parsing are intentional. Unicode PLAIN identities are supported; general SASLprep/Unicode RFC preparation conformance is excluded.

Existing admitted sessions deliberately retain their bounded whole credential generation; rotation governs subsequent admissions. The credential count bounds one generation, rather than promising only one retained generation process-wide.

Fixed-size secret equality uses the constant-time dependency API. Tests of first/middle/last mismatch are functional checks, not a statistical timing proof; malformed-message and unknown-user timing are not uniform.
Caller copies, exported persistence buffers, compiler/register copies and PBKDF2 internal raw temporaries are outside an all-memory scrubbing guarantee.
Cancelled running PBKDF2 cannot be preempted; it retains the bounded worker permit and secret until actual completion. No cancelled caller can receive its success.
Finite source review and oracle cases do not establish production security qualification or exhaustive parsing/cryptographic correctness.
rust_execution_attribution: Frozen stable/MSRV Rust gates are performed separately by the mechanism worker; this artifact records source review only.
